text:
anya: FYI bringing up Zephyr-v1 q5->q8 on staging, seen a regression on CJK date ranges where output inserts extra spacing and duplicated date phrase. filing here.
sam: can you paste a minimal example?
anya: sure — repro snippet:
```
src: 我们将在2024-01-15至2024-01-20之间迁移。
ref: We will migrate between 2024-01-15 and 2024-01-20.
zephyr-q8: We will migrate from 2024 年 1 月 15 日 到 2024 年 1 月 20 日。
```
(note the extra fullwidth spacing and repeated year token in en output)
li: float32 runs look fine?
anya: correct, zephyr-fp32 outputs the expected one-liner. q8 only.
jorge: could be tokenizer split/merge difference after quant kernels change. can you dump tokenizer tokens for src and zephyr detok map?
anya: token dump (zephyr tok): `[CLS] 我 们 将 在 2024 - 01 - 15 至 2024 - 01 - 20 之 间 迁 移 。 [SEP]`
sam: hyphens separated around numbers — normalization maybe toggling between ascii hyphen and fullwidth 
? any runtime path differences between fp32 and q8 (kv-cache / reflow)?
anya: logs show `reflow_patch=True` on q8 requests for some prefixes. suspect runtime fallback path triggered that reflow and detok thresholds differ.
li: sounds like a detokenize merging threshold changed (merge if |gap|<X) — quant kernel could change subtoken logits enough to flip boundary decisions.
jorge: start a quick shadow eval on date-numeric slice comparing fp32 vs q8. I'll also ping infra to list kernel ids for the build.
ci-bot: ci:trigger shadow-eval --suite date_numeric_slice --models zephyr-fp32,zephyr-q8 --env staging
infra-team: pinged. looks like q8 used kernel-set v2.4.3 which swapped a matmul tiling kernel.
sam: short-term mitigation: add a post-detok pass normalizing date ranges with a conservative regex and collapse extra spaces. not ideal but blocks customer impact.
li: also add the date-numeric slice to nightly regressions and block q8 prod canary for now.
anya: bisect started to find the commit that introduced kernel-set v2.4.3 usage. will report back when CI returns.
ci-bot: shadow-eval queued (job 123781). results ETA ~10m.
